## Summary:
Added docstring documentation for the `folly.iobuf.IOBuf` Python class as part of the DevInfra Code Docathon 2025.

The documentation includes:
- High-level description of IOBuf's purpose (zero-copy buffer management)
- Key features (buffer sharing, chaining, Python buffer protocol compatibility)
- Usage examples showing common operations (creation, access, chaining)
- Thread safety notes for multi-threaded usage
- References to related classes and C++ documentation

The docstring provides developers with clear guidance on using the IOBuf class for efficient network programming and data processing.
